components.name: Icon
components.summary: Inline SVG for one of the Carbon glyphs extracted from the Figma kit; paints with currentColor.

components.name: Button
components.summary: The standard Carbon action; use primary for the single most important action per view and ghost for low-emphasis inline actions.

components.name: ComboButton
components.summary: A split primary button: the label fires the default action, the chevron opens alternates.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: An icon-only button whose label appears as a Carbon tooltip — use it anywhere a bare glyph would otherwise be unlabelled (toolbars, table row actions, shell he…

components.name: Link
components.summary: Text navigation. \inline\ for links inside a paragraph (always underlined); standalone for links on their own line (underline on hover only).

components.name: MenuButton
components.summary: A button whose only job is to open a menu of related actions — use when three or more actions share one entry point.

components.name: OverflowMenu
components.summary: The three-dot affordance for actions that belong to one row, card or tile.

components.name: CodeSnippet
components.summary: Always IBM Plex Mono at 12px/16px on --cds-layer-01.

components.name: ContainedList
components.summary: A titled list with its own header action — good for side panels and dashboard cards.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: The workhorse for structured records.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Sits directly under a DataTable, flush to its edges, on --cds-layer-01\ with a 1px top rule.

components.name: StructuredList
components.summary: For reading, not manipulating — use when rows need no sorting, selection bar or pagination.

components.name: Tag
components.summary: Categorises or filters.

components.name: Tile
components.summary: Carbon's container primitive.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Zero-or-more selection.

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: A date field with a calendar flyout. \range\ renders two fields side by side with a 1px gap.

components.name: Dropdown
components.summary: Single-select from a list that may be long or need custom option rendering.

components.name: FileUploader
components.summary: Two modes: a tertiary "Add file" button, or \drop\ for a 320px dashed drag-and-drop zone.

components.name: Form
components.summary: Form layout primitives.

components.name: NumberInput
components.summary: Numeric entry with steppers.

components.name: PasswordInput
components.summary: A text input with an eye toggle.

components.name: RadioButton
components.summary: Exactly-one selection from two to five visible options.

components.name: Search
components.summary: Filters or queries a set.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Use Select for a short, fixed list the user already knows (country, region, plan).

components.name: Slider
components.summary: For imprecise values where relative position matters more than the exact number.

components.name: TextArea
components.summary: Multi-line input.

components.name: TextInput
components.summary: The default single-line field.

components.name: TimePicker
components.summary: An 80px time field followed by period and time-zone Selects, joined by 1px gaps.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: A toggle applies immediately — no Save button.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Slash-separated hierarchy, placed directly above a page title.

components.name: ContentSwitcher
components.summary: Toggles between two to four views of the same content — a grid/list switch, a chart type.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: The floating list of actions.

components.name: SideNav
components.summary: The shell's left panel: 256px expanded, 48px as a rail, rows 32px tall.

components.name: SwitcherPanel
components.summary: The shell's right drawer — app switcher, account menu or notification list.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Switches between peer views of the same data.

components.name: TreeView
components.summary: Nested hierarchies where depth matters — file trees, resource groups, taxonomy pickers.

components.name: UIShellHeader
components.summary: The product header: always 48px tall, always --cds-background-inverse\, always first in the DOM.

components.name: Actions
components.summary: Button, IconButton, Link, MenuButton, ComboButton, OverflowMenu

components.name: Data
components.summary: DataTable, Pagination, Tag, Tile, CodeSnippet, structured and contained lists

components.name: Forms
components.summary: Text, number, password, select, dropdown, checkbox, radio, toggle, search, slider, date, time, uploader

components.name: Navigation
components.summary: Breadcrumb, Tabs, ContentSwitcher, Menu, SideNav, TreeView, shell header
